segment.source: Leaving the hidden Rebel Combat Training Facilities.
segment.target: 離開隱密的反抗軍戰鬥訓練設施。

segment.source: We've found him!
segment.target: 我們找到他了！

segment.source: He's OK.
segment.target: 他沒事。

segment.source: Arriving at Rebel Fleet Medical Ship, the Salvation.
segment.target: 抵達反抗軍艦隊醫療艦「救贖號」（Salvation）。

segment.source: There's the rebel!
segment.target: 反抗軍在那裡！

segment.source: Bring him in.
segment.target: 把他抓上來。

segment.source: Arriving at the Executor. Flagship of the Empire!
segment.target: 抵達「執行者號」（Executor）——帝國的旗艦！

segment.source: Now we will discuss the position
segment.target: 現在我們該來好好談談

segment.source: of the secret rebel base!
segment.target: 反抗軍祕密基地的位置了！

segment.source: Returning to the hidden Rebel Combat Training Facilities.
segment.target: 返回隱密的反抗軍戰鬥訓練設施。

segment.source: Leaving the hidden Rebel Training Facilities.
segment.target: 離開隱密的反抗軍訓練設施。

segment.source: Leaving the Defiance.
segment.target: 離開「蔑視號」（Defiance）。

segment.source: Returning to the Defiance.
segment.target: 返回「蔑視號」（Defiance）。

segment.source: Star Destroyer patrol near the planet Turkana
segment.target: 滅星艦於圖爾卡納星（Turkana）附近的巡邏隊

segment.source: Sir, our TIE Interceptors have located a
segment.target: 長官，我們的鈦截擊機發現了一支

segment.source: Rebel Fleet orbiting the planet Turkana.
segment.target: 在圖爾卡納星軌道上的反抗軍艦隊。

segment.source: Excellent! Prepare the attack.
segment.target: 太好了！準備展開攻擊。

segment.source: Move our Star Destroyers within range
segment.target: 將我們的滅星艦移至射程範圍內，

segment.source: and launch all TIE Fighter Squadrons.
segment.target: 並出動所有鈦戰機中隊。

segment.source: At once, Sir!
segment.target: 遵命，長官！

segment.source: On board the Rebel Flagship Independence.
segment.target: 反抗軍旗艦「獨立號」（Independence）艦上。

segment.source: We are under attack by Imperial Star Destroyers!
segment.target: 我們遭到帝國滅星艦的攻擊！

segment.source: Begin evasive maneuvers. Launch the X-Wing fighters.
segment.target: 開始規避機動。出動 X翼戰機。

segment.source: This is Red Leader. Stay close
segment.target: 這裡是紅色長官。保持緊密隊形，

segment.source: and watch for enemy fighters.
segment.target: 並警戒敵方戰機。

segment.source: I got him.
segment.target: 我打中他了。

segment.source: Follow me.
segment.target: 跟著我。

segment.source: I can't shake him!
segment.target: 我甩不掉他！

segment.source: I'm on him.
segment.target: 我咬住他了。

segment.source: Nice shot, Red Two!
segment.target: 好球，紅二號！

segment.source: Star Destroyer fleet orbiting a
segment.target: 滅星艦艦隊正環繞軌道，

segment.source: Rebel base on the planet Orion IV.
segment.target: 封鎖奧賴恩四號星（Orion IV）上的反抗軍基地。

segment.source: AT-AT Walkers advance on the Rebel base.
segment.target: AT-AT 全地形裝甲步行載具正向反抗軍基地推進。

segment.source: Planet has been secured.
segment.target: 該星球已受帝國控制。

segment.source: Rebel agents on approach to Star Destroyer Invincible.
segment.target: 反抗軍特工正接近滅星艦「無敵號」（Invincible）。

segment.source: Security codes approved. Shuttle landing in Main Bay.
segment.target: 安全辨識碼核准。穿梭機降落於主機庫。

segment.source: Is that it?
segment.target: 就這些了嗎？

segment.source: Yes, that's the last crate.
segment.target: 是的，那是最後一個板條箱。

segment.source: Alright, lift off.
segment.target: 好的，起飛。

segment.source: Hidden among the crates, the Rebels have
segment.target: 隱藏在貨物板條箱之中，

segment.source: planted a powerful explosive device.
segment.target: 反抗軍安裝了一枚威力強大的炸藥裝置。

segment.source: Rebel Corvette deploying captured
segment.target: 反抗軍巡邏艦正在部署

segment.source: Imperial Communication Satellites.
segment.target: 繳獲的帝國通訊衛星。

segment.source: The modified CommSats scatter into deep space.
segment.target: 改裝後的通訊衛星散布至深空之中。

segment.source: A lone CommSat transmits near the Cron Drift,
segment.target: 一顆孤立的通訊衛星在克隆漂移帶（Cron Drift）附近發射訊號，

segment.source: sending Imperial data to a nearby Rebel outpost.
segment.target: 將帝國數據傳送至鄰近的反抗軍前哨站。

segment.source: Rebel listening post Ax-235 in an
segment.target: 位於克隆漂移帶小行星帶中的

segment.source: asteroid field within the Cron Drift.
segment.target: 反抗軍 Ax-235 監聽哨。

segment.source: We just intercepted a transmission.
segment.target: 我們剛剛攔截到一段通訊傳輸。

segment.source: Sounds like an Imperial code.
segment.target: 聽起來像是帝國軍用密碼。

segment.source: That's right! I'm decoding it now.
segment.target: 沒錯！我正在進行解密。

segment.source: Looks like plans for an Imperial Battle Station!
segment.target: 看起來像是帝國戰鬥太空站的設計藍圖！

segment.source: Relay it with the next High Security transmissions.
segment.target: 請隨同下一批極機密通訊一起轉發。

segment.source: Enroute to the planet Alderaan, the Corellian Corvette
segment.target: 在前往奧德昂星（Alderaan）的途中，搭載莉亞公主的

segment.source: transporting Princess Leia receives a vital message.
segment.target: 柯爾里亞巡邏艦收到了一則至關重要的訊息。

segment.source: Here are the secret plans, Princess Leia.
segment.target: 這是機密藍圖，莉亞公主。

segment.source: I will bring them safely to Alderaan.
segment.target: 我會將它們安全送達奧德昂星。

segment.source: Imperial Fleet on course for Tatooine.
segment.target: 帝國艦隊正駛向塔圖因星（Tatooine）。

segment.source: I have you now!
segment.target: 這下抓到你了！

segment.source: Imperial Death Star in final stages of construction.
segment.target: 帝國死星已進入最後建造階段。

segment.source: Arrival of Darth Vader, Envoy of the Emperor.
segment.target: 達斯·維達——帝皇特使抵達現場。

segment.source: Congratulations, the Death Star is
segment.target: 恭喜，死星已經建造完成。

segment.source: complete. The Emperor will be pleased.
segment.target: 帝皇將會非常滿意。

segment.source: I think it is time we demonstrated
segment.target: 我想是時候向世人展示

segment.source: the full power of this station.
segment.target: 這座太空站的終極威力了。

segment.source: This station is insignificant compared
segment.target: 與原力的宏大力量相比，

segment.source: with the power of the force.
segment.target: 這座太空站根本微不足道。

segment.source: You may fire when ready.
segment.target: 準備就緒即可開火。

segment.source: Imperial Death Star on approach to Alderaan.
segment.target: 帝國死星逼近奧德昂星。

segment.source: You may fire when ready.
segment.target: 準備就緒即可開火。

segment.source: Approaching Yavin Moon Base.
segment.target: 正在接近雅汶衛星基地。

segment.source: Yavin Rebel Base. Headquarters of the Rebellion.
segment.target: 雅汶反抗軍基地——反抗軍同盟的大本營。

segment.source: Darth Vader's shuttle arrives at Plooriod III.
segment.target: 達斯·維達的穿梭機降落於普魯里奧德三號星（Plooriod III）。

segment.source: Lord Vader! What a great privilege to have
segment.target: 維達閣下！真是不勝榮幸，

segment.source: you unexpectedly grace my humble domain.
segment.target: 您竟然不期而至，親臨我這微不足道的領地。

segment.source: How may I serve you?
segment.target: 不知我有何能為您效勞？

segment.source: We received your grain shipments, Ghorin...
segment.target: 我們收到了你運送的糧食批次，高林（Ghorin）……

segment.source: and the Emperor has sent me here to
segment.target: 而帝皇派我前來，

segment.source: personally repay you for your treachery.
segment.target: 就是為了親自好好回報你的背叛之舉。

segment.source: Imperial Drydock IV, Greater Plooriad Sector.
segment.target: 大普魯里亞德星區第四帝國乾塢。

segment.source: Interdictor Cruisers respond to Fleet Summons.
segment.target: 阻絕者巡洋艦響應艦隊集結號召。

segment.source: Outer Rim Imperial Fleet preparing for battle.
segment.target: 邊境星域帝國艦隊正在備戰。

segment.source: Interdictors join the fleet for attack on Rebels.
segment.target: 阻絕者加入艦隊，準備向反抗軍發動進攻。

segment.source: Ramming course locked in.
segment.target: 撞擊航向已鎖定。

segment.source: Right! Let's get out of here.
segment.target: 好！我們快離開這裡。

segment.source: New B-wings arrive at Rebel Fleet.
segment.target: 全新 B翼戰機抵達反抗軍艦隊。

segment.source: Lt. Farlander, do you have
segment.target: 法蘭德中尉，B翼戰機

segment.source: the B-wings combat-ready?
segment.target: 做好戰鬥準備了嗎？

segment.source: Yes Cmdr. Skywalker, they will be a
segment.target: 報告天行者指揮官，是的！它們將會是

segment.source: powerful new weapon against the Empire.
segment.target: 對抗帝國的強力新武器。

segment.source: Good work, Lieutenant.
segment.target: 幹得好，中尉。

segment.source: Two Rebel ships work in conjunction to replace
segment.target: 兩艘反抗軍船艦協同合作，

segment.source: Imperial probes with modified Rebel probes.
segment.target: 以改裝過的反抗軍探測器替換帝國探測器。

segment.source: Inside the cargo ship, modified probes are
segment.target: 在貨船內部，改裝後的探測器

segment.source: readied for release.
segment.target: 已準備好進行釋放。

segment.source: Each Imperial probe is replaced in a quick swap.
segment.target: 每顆帝國探測器都在迅捷的交替中被順利替換。

segment.source: Rebel Fleet arrives at the planet Hoth.
segment.target: 反抗軍艦隊抵達霍斯星（Hoth）。

segment.source: General, what word is there of
segment.target: 將軍，關於我們從哈巴薩星（Habassa）的撤離行動，

segment.source: our evacuation from Habassa?
segment.target: 有任何新消息嗎？

segment.source: The fleet has arrived safely, Princess.
segment.target: 艦隊已安全抵達，公主。

segment.source: Thank goodness. Is our Hoth base operational?
segment.target: 感謝老天。我們在霍斯星的基地已能正常運作了嗎？

segment.source: Yes, the Rebel Alliance has
segment.target: 是的，反抗軍同盟

segment.source: found a new home.
segment.target: 已經找到了一座新家園。

segment.source: Congratulations on behalf of the Rebel Alliance.
segment.target: 謹代表反抗軍同盟向你表達最誠摯的恭賀。

segment.source: Returning to the hidden Rebel Training Facilities.
segment.target: 返回隱密的反抗軍訓練設施。

segment.source: Leaving the Alliance Flagship Independence.
segment.target: 離開同盟旗艦「獨立號」（Independence）。

segment.source: Preparing for the jump to hyperspace.
segment.target: 正在準備超空間跳躍。

segment.source: Arriving at the hidden Rebel Training Facilities.
segment.target: 抵達隱密的反抗軍訓練設施。

segment.source: Arriving at the hidden Rebel Combat Training Facilities.
segment.target: 抵達隱密的反抗軍戰鬥訓練設施。

segment.source: Arriving at the Calamari Cruiser Defiance.
segment.target: 抵達蒙卡拉馬里巡洋艦「蔑視號」（Defiance）。

segment.source: Returning to Independence.
segment.target: 返回「獨立號」（Independence）。

segment.source: This is Red Leader. Don't worry
segment.target: 這裡是紅色長官。別灰心，

segment.source: about it. Try again.
segment.target: 這沒什麼大不了的。再試一次。

segment.source: This is Red Leader. Not bad.
segment.target: 這裡是紅色長官。還不賴。

segment.source: But you still need training.
segment.target: 但你依然需要更多訓練。

segment.source: This is Red Leader. Excellent!
segment.target: 這裡是紅色長官。太出色了！

segment.source: You're ready for combat!
segment.target: 你已經準備好迎接實戰了！

segment.source: An Imperial fleet is heading for the Rebel Base at Ralltir. You must try to delay the attack.
segment.target: 一支帝國艦隊正駛向拉爾提爾星（Ralltiir）的反抗軍基地。你必須竭力拖延他們的攻勢。

segment.source: An Imperial fleet is heading for the Rebel Base at Ralltir. You must try to delay the attack.
segment.target: 一支帝國艦隊正駛向拉爾提爾星的反抗軍基地。你必須竭力拖延他們的攻勢。

segment.source: The Imperial Fleet is attacking a Rebel Base with AT-AT walkers and Assault Gunboats.
segment.target: 帝國艦隊正動用 AT-AT 步行載具與突擊砲艇進攻反抗軍基地。

segment.source: The Rebels sneak on board an Imperial Star Destroyer and plant a bomb.
segment.target: 反抗軍悄悄潛入一艘帝國滅星艦並安裝了炸彈。

segment.source: The plans for the Death Star are intercepted by a Rebel outpost.
segment.target: 死星的設計藍圖被一座反抗軍前哨站成功攔截。

segment.source: The plans for the Death Star are transmitted to the ship containing Princess Leia.
segment.target: 死星的設計藍圖被傳送至莉亞公主所在的座艦。

segment.source: The Death Star is completed and destroys the planet used for building resources.
segment.target: 死星建造完成，並摧毀了曾用於開採資源的星球。

segment.source: The Death Star destroys the planet Alderaan as a means of terrorizing the galaxy.
segment.target: 死星摧毀了奧德昂星，藉此威嚇並恐嚇整個銀河系。

segment.source: The Death Star is destroyed by a Rebel attack. The rebels return to Yavin to celebrate.
segment.target: 死星在反抗軍的英勇突襲中被徹底摧毀。反抗軍返回雅汶慶祝勝利。

segment.source: The Rebels flee from Yavin before the Imperial Fleet can retaliate.
segment.target: 反抗軍在帝國艦隊展開報復之前迅速撤離雅汶星。

segment.source: Overlord Ghorin is killed by Darth Vader for giving poison grain to the empire.
segment.target: 大領主高林因向帝國提供有毒糧食而被達斯·維達處決。

segment.source: Imperial Interdictors are taken from a repair dock to join the main Imperial Fleet.
segment.target: 帝國阻絕者巡洋艦從維修乾塢被抽調，加入帝國主力艦隊。

segment.source: An unprotected Imperial repair dock is rammed by an unmanned Rebel Corvette.
segment.target: 一座缺乏防備的帝國維修乾塢遭到一艘無人駕駛的反抗軍巡邏艦直接撞擊。

segment.source: The B-Wing Starfighter is brought on-line by Luke Skywalker and Lt. Farlander.
segment.target: 盧克·天行者與法蘭德中尉將 B翼星際戰機正式投入服役。

segment.source: The Rebel Alliance swaps Imperial Probes with Rebel Probes during an evacuation.
segment.target: 反抗軍同盟在撤退行動期間將帝國探測器替換為反抗軍探測器。

segment.source: The Rebellion arrives at Hoth, where a new base for the Rebel Alliance will be built.
segment.target: 反抗軍抵達霍斯星，反抗軍同盟的新基地即將在此建立。
